verdict.rationale: Community evidence shows Ollama does emit some diagnostic log lines when GPU acceleration fails (e.g., 'amdgpu detected, but no compatible rocm library found... falling back to CPU'), indicating the underlying mechanism exists, but there is no first-party documentation describing this diagnostic system, no guidance on how to surface or interpret it, and other users report unexplained slow performance suggesting the fallback isn't always clearly communicated (comm-10). missing for 10: official docs on GPU-fallback diagnostics, guidance on enabling verbose/diagnostic logging, and consistent user reports confirming the messages are clear and discoverable.
